proof:
classical
intro b t w ht z i
have hh := congrArg (fun z => b.repr (t z) i) (b.sum_repr z)
simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ht, Finsupp.sum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, b.repr_self_apply] at hh
simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hh.symm

checked : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_2) [addV : AddCommGroup V] [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ)
  (l : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (rho : ↥LR.L →ₗ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥LR.L) (v : V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
    LR.ComplexHyp l rho x y h →
      LR.Strings l (rho x) (rho y) (rho h) v →
        ((∀ (i : LR.I l), LR.eNat (rho y) v ↑i ≠ 0) ∧ LinearIndependent ℂ fun i => LR.eNat (rho y) v ↑i) →
          ∀ (b : Module.Basis (LR.I l) ℂ V) (t : Module.End ℂ V) (w : LR.I l → ℂ),
            (∀ (i : LR.I l), t (b i) = w i • b i) → ∀ (z : V) (i : LR.I l), (b.repr (t z)) i = w i * (b.repr z) i
